item.title: Justin Wong and Marn face off in a modded version of Ultimate Marvel vs. Capcom 3 filled with surprise characters

item.title: It's your last chance to sign up for Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls' second beta test
item.description: <p>There's a couple of big fighting game tests going down this weekend, and you still have a little bit of time to sign up for at least one of them.</p> <p>PlayStation and Arc System Works are set to conduct the <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/nov/11/marvel-tokon-second-beta/">second closed beta test for Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls</a>, but time is running out to try and get in on the action.</p>

item.title: New Build Your Own Capcom Ultimate Bundle from Fanatical includes the Capcom Fighting Collection 2 and more at unbeatable prices
item.description: <p>While most <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/nov/27/black-friday-fighting-game-sales/">Black Friday deals</a> may be over with now, we're still finding more ways to save on big fighting games this holiday season.</p> <p>Fanatical is now running a new Build Your Own Capcom Ultimate Bundle, which can let you pick up a number of Capcom's largest titles at a nice discount as the name suggests.</p>

item.title: Street Fighter League Pro-US 2025 early results, stream ft. MenaRD, Xiaohai, Punk, Blaz, DualKevin, Nephew, Craime, Vxbao, Zhen, NuckleDu and more

item.title: Cary-Hiroyuki Tagawa, iconic actor for Mortal Kombat's Shang Tsung, has sadly passed away at 75 years old
item.description: <p>The realm of fighting games and the world at large has lost a star who captured the hearts (and souls) of millions.</p> <p>Cary-Hiroyuki Tagawa, the iconic actor for Mortal Kombat's Shang Tsung, has sadly passed away.</p>
